title: FCT Flex Assembly Detects Leaks in Liquid-Cooled Systems
summary: FCT introduced a flex assembly supporting custom sensing patterns and detection zones for liquid-cooled systems.

title: Chip Industry Technical Paper Roundup Released
summary: A technical paper roundup highlights recent research on AI thermal modeling, chiplet co-design, and LLM EDA orchestration.

title: DfT Sets Framework for Great British Railway's 30-Year Rail Plan
summary: The UK Department for Transport published a briefing paper outlining a 30-year rail strategy to guide future investment.

title: Report Analyzes US STEM Talent Pipeline and Global Competitiveness
summary: A comprehensive index combining decades of data assesses how the United States develops, attracts, deploys, and retains its STEM workforce.

title: Retrofitting Residential Septic Tanks for Biogas in Lagos
summary: A study evaluates retrofitting residential septic infrastructure in Lagos for decentralised biogas production, estimating a methane yield of 10.89 m3/day.

title: Detecting Hardware Trojans in Synthesized Gate-Level Netlists
summary: Researchers proposed LoRD, a lightweight heuristic-based approach to detect hardware Trojans in synthesized gate-level netlists.

title: Concurrent HBM and Host Memory Access Accelerates LLM Inference
summary: Researchers presented BOOST, a runtime system enabling concurrent access to host memory and HBM to improve LLM inference throughput.

title: UCLA Researchers Explore LLM Agents for High-Level Chip Design
summary: A published paper explores whether LLM agents can design better chips by operating at higher levels of abstraction using HLS.

title: Multiple Orbital Launches Scheduled
summary: A total of five orbital launches are scheduled this week, featuring Electron, Falcon 9, and Starship.

title: Prosthetics and Haptic Feedback Interfaces
summary: Researcher Jeremy Brown discusses ongoing work developing haptic feedback interfaces for upper-limb prosthetics, rehabilitation, and surgical robotics.

title: Singapore Advances Quantum Technologies Hub
summary: Singapore is establishing a regional hub for quantum technologies driven by government funding and commercial focus.

title: Senate Passes Hydropower Relicensing Act
summary: The U.S. Senate has passed the Hydropower Relicensing Transparency Act to improve efficiency in hydropower licensing.

title: Unimore Racing Wins Autonomous Challenge
summary: Unimore Racing won the Indy Autonomous Challenge at Laguna Seca, featuring the event's first autonomous car overtakes on a road course.

title: GLIDE Framework Improves Robot Learning
summary: Researchers proposed GLIDE, a framework that infers task-specific failure modes to create guardrails for robot behavior cloning without human demonstrations.

title: MIGU Framework for Multimodal Instruction
summary: MIGU combines semantic and geometric evidence into a unified grounding belief to improve robot manipulation planning under uncertainty.

title: In-Silico Study Evaluates VAD Controller
summary: An in-silico study demonstrates that a new integrated system architecture for ventricular assist devices improves physiological regulation and mitigates adverse events.

title: Robotic Pruning in Orchards via Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
summary: Researchers developed a visuomotor robotic pruning controller for planar fruit orchards trained entirely in simulation and transferred zero-shot to physical trials.

title: Modular Design Framework Enables Steerable and Reactive Grasping
summary: A new framework combines geometric heatmap sampling, model-based reactive control, and reinforcement learning to achieve stable dexterous grasping across objects.

title: Exolaunch and Space Cargo Book Starship Starfall Missions
summary: Exolaunch and Space Cargo have booked missions on SpaceX's Starship utilizing the Starfall reentry capsule.

title: Dual-System World Action Models Speed Up Robot Control
summary: A dual-system world action model decouples global planning from local refinement to deliver high-frequency closed-loop action updates and faster execution.

title: Path Planning for LTL Specifications with Visit Proportions
summary: Researchers proposed a path-planning approach that satisfies linear temporal logic specifications while maintaining a desired long-run visit proportion.

title: SE(3) Neural Potential Fields for 6-DoF Trajectory Planning
summary: A new method learns SE(3) potential fields directly from posed RGB images to generate collision-free 6-DoF grasp trajectories without explicit 3D reconstruction.

title: Range-Aided SLAM Initialization Using Accurate Heading Data
summary: A two-step initialization method for range-aided simultaneous localization and mapping utilizes accurate heading information to estimate transponder and AUV positions.

title: Collision-Aware Assembly Framework for Construction Robots
summary: A single factor graph framework combines trajectory estimation and planning with collision and cable constraints to coordinate multi-robot construction tasks.

title: Predictive Action Diffusion Policy for Onboard Humanoid Control
summary: PredActor uses predictive action diffusion on an onboard computer to jointly generate executable actions and future-state trajectories for humanoid control.

title: Minimum Time Trajectories for Car-Like Robots with Non-Sliding Constraints
summary: Researchers formulated non-sliding wheel constraints based on robot dynamics to determine time-optimal trajectories and path primitives for car-like mobile robots.

title: Graph Neural Automata Clustering via Local Cell Interactions
summary: Graph Neural Automata Clustering is an unsupervised clustering method that evolves latent domain states through local interactions on a neighborhood graph.

title: Hyperspectral Characterization of RGB-to-S/P Ratio for Displays
summary: Researchers evaluated a closed-form RGB-to-S/P luminance ratio estimator on natural broadband scenes using hyperspectral imagery and found it achieves low median error when chromatically adapted.

title: Uranus Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
summary: Uranus is a data-driven robot simulator utilizing an autoregressive diffusion model to generate streaming latent frames for multi-view robot control at 24 FPS.

title: Fast Time-Varying Exponentiated Convolution for Spatial Audio
summary: A new convolution method transforms Gaussian noise and impulse responses into reverberation fields and modified spectral-decay fields for spatial audio reproduction.
